searchText: I haven't been following the latest beacon-api proposal for retrieving blobs. I think the latest proposal is to use `beacon_root` or `beacon_slot` to retrieve blobs. How about `execution_block_hash`? Would that be useful to others? <realbigsean> Me and pawan were actually just talking about this, if you don’t need to sign the blobs then the beacon apu could be unchanged Regarding whether to sign blobs in gossip - from the call it sounded like one reason to still sign blobs is to avoid making `validate_blobs_sidecar` (validating commitments against blobs using the kzg proof) a gossip condition. Me and pawan are benchmarking with this library - https://github.com/crate-crypto/proto-danksharding-crypto - and seeing this verification take 10-20 ms. Does this sound about right? Yup, that matches the benchmarks we've done using go-kzg and c-kzg. does anyone have benchmarks on single signature verification? Curious to know how that compares. I think <@361447803194441738> is gonna benchmark blob signature verification today, and if not I'll check it out tomorrow https://notes.ethereum.org/@timbeiko/4844-devnet-3 rough draft of a target "spec" for devnet 3 will add to the agenda for the call next week, but just wanted to gather everything that's current WIP in one place. there may be things we think are worth keeping out of scope for now, but I think that's at least the (current) scope of things being worked on

excerpts.author: realbigsean
excerpts.content:
Regarding whether to sign blobs in gossip -  from the call it sounded like one reason to still sign blobs is to avoid making `validate_blobs_sidecar` (validating commitments against blobs using the kzg proof) a gossip condition. 

Me and pawan are benchmarking with this library - https://github.com/crate-crypto/proto-danksharding-crypto - and seeing this  verification take 10-20 ms. Does this sound about right?
